name: Shutterstock
summary: Stock photo library with an AI image generator, licensed downloads and image packs.
best_for: marketers and creators who want AI images with exact on-image text next to a licensed stock photo library, and are happy to subscribe to download
skip_if: you want to download and keep a generated image without a subscription, or need proof of the licence file before you pay
honest_knock: Free generation ends at two prompts, and downloading a generated image needs a GenAI subscription. Previews carry a watermark until you licence them. The licence panel warns that generated images are not reviewed for brand or public person likeness. Prices appeared in euros on our connection and we did not pay, so we did not see the final file or licence certificate.

sessions.what: Our AI assistant ran the test on 22 November 2026 on shutterstock.com with an existing free account and the site switched to English. We used both free AI image generations with a prompt that asked for exact text on a card, opened a result to download it, tried a third generation, and read the prices on a stock photo page. We paid nothing.
findings: Language: the account opened on the Dutch site; the globe menu switched it to English.
Free AI generations: the generator page offered two free generations. Each one returned four images in under 20 seconds on the Automatic model.

Text in images: we asked for a coffee mug next to a card that reads exactly SPRING SALE 20% OFF. All eight images spelled the card text right. Some changed the scene: one mug had a flower print and several held coffee.

Download: a generated image showed a Shutterstock AI-Generated Image watermark. Download as JPEG opened a licence panel that required a GenAI subscription and a tick box saying the image has not been reviewed and must not be used if it contains the likeness of a brand or public person.
Free limit: a third generation opened a plan screen instead of generating.

Prices on 22 November 2026 in euros: GenAI EUR 9 a month billed yearly (EUR 108) or EUR 19 with no contract, for 100 generation credits a month; Unlimited Plus EUR 49 a month billed yearly; on a stock photo page Unlimited Images at EUR 29 a month, or packs from EUR 18 for one image to EUR 169 for 25.
not_tested: downloading or licensing anything: we paid nothing, so we did not see an unwatermarked file or the licence certificate
the paid AI plans: we used only the two free generations on the default Automatic model and did not pick a model ourselves
the AI image editor, video generation and Image reference
